headword: {入院|にゅういん}{患者|かんじゃ}
gloss: inpatient; a patient admitted to and staying in a hospital for treatment

definitions.gloss: inpatient; a patient admitted to and staying in a hospital for treatment
definitions.explanation: inpatient; a patient admitted to and staying in a hospital for treatment

examples.japanese: {入院|にゅういん}{患者|かんじゃ}の{面会|めんかい}{時間|じかん}は{午後|ごご}{三時|さんじ}までです。
examples.english: Visiting hours for inpatients are until 3 PM.

examples.japanese: この{病棟|びょうとう}には{約|やく}{五十|ごじゅう}{名|めい}の{入院|にゅういん}{患者|かんじゃ}がいる。
examples.english: There are about fifty inpatients in this ward.

examples.japanese: {入院|にゅういん}{患者|かんじゃ}の{食事|しょくじ}は{栄養士|えいようし}が{管理|かんり}している。
examples.english: The meals for inpatients are managed by a nutritionist.

notes:
A compound of {入院|にゅういん} (hospitalization) and {患者|かんじゃ} (patient). Used in medical and administrative contexts to distinguish from {外来|がいらい}{患者|かんじゃ} (outpatient).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入院|にゅういん}{患者|かんじゃ}{数|すう} — number of inpatients
- {入院|にゅういん}{患者|かんじゃ}の{ケア|けあ} — inpatient care
- {入院|にゅういん}{患者|かんじゃ}{用|よう} — for inpatient use
- {長期|ちょうき}{入院|にゅういん}{患者|かんじゃ} — long-term inpatient

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外来|がいらい}{患者|かんじゃ} — outpatient (visits the hospital without staying overnight)
- {通院|つういん}{患者|かんじゃ} — patient who commutes to the hospital for regular treatment
- {入所者|にゅうしょしゃ} — resident (of a care facility, not a hospital)
